item.text:
Refactored the design again by splitting validation from graph assembly.

What changed:
- Added [GraphInputValidator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/GraphInputValidator.java) to own all input checks.
- Simplified [UndirectedGraphFactory.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/UndirectedGraphFactory.java) so it now just assembles an immutable graph from validated edge data.
- Kept [UndirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/UndirectedGraph.java) focused purely on graph state and access.
- Preserved the existing analyzer and facade shape in [BipartiteAnalyzer.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/BipartiteAnalyzer.java) and [BipartiteGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/BipartiteGraph.java).

Why this is better:
- Validation is now isolated and reusable.
- The factory no longer mixes policy and construction.
- The graph model stays immutable without redundant copying in the model layer.
